name: Furniture Factory Outlet
old_description: Don't get left out in the cold, nice weather is just around the corner.
about:
Furniture Factory Outlet operates two retail locations in Mississippi, at 414 Highway 61 N Suite 2 in Natchez and 1350 Furniture Row Lane in Brookhaven. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The retailer sells home furnishings across categories including living room, dining room, bedroom, home decor, kids' furniture, outdoor furniture, and mattresses. It offers in-store layaway and financing options for customers.

The business serves residential consumers rather than industrial or commercial buyers. No specific industries or B2B customer types are identified in the provided materials.

The company has not published a stated differentiation or founding mission in the provided materials.
